findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: There was a major leaking coming from the faucet handle of the kitchen’s handwashing sink. The PIC mentioned that a plumber will be to service the sink very soon. Ensure that faucet handles are maintained in good repair and always in a leak free condition.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: The PIC was observed handling food with gloved hands and then touching the handle of the paper towel dispenser. The PIC then proceeded to handle food. Discussed proper glove use with PIC. If tasks are interrupted during food handling, be sure to always change gloves and wash hands before doing so to prevent contaminating food.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.15(A) Gloves, Use Limitation. (A) If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only one task such as working with ready-to-eat food or with raw animal food, used for no other purpose, and discarded when damaged or soiled, or when interruptions occur in the operation.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12 PIC has an expired food manager certification and is in the process of renewing. See additional comments for additional information.
Person in charge at the time of inspection shall be a certified food protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an accredited program.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Signed copies of employee health reporting agreements were not available for owner or staff working at the time of inspection. Employee health documents were provided and discussed, including reporting agreements, which were signed at the time of inspection. Additional copies of reporting agreement were left for owner to have other part time staff review and sign. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring and sign reporting agreements prior to beginning their first shift. Maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under  2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 Sec. 3.07 Owner has an allergen certification that expired as of April 2023. Requirements for allergen training were discussed. Ensure food allergen certification is completed by the next routine inspection
Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment: PA 100-0367, Section 3.07 Not all of the certified food managers have completed the required online food allergen awareness training. Requirements for allergen training were discussed, and information was provided for management to find an online course. All certified food managers need to complete the food allergen awareness training by the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment: All CFM's are required to complete a certified allergen awareness training course.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
750.510, 512, 514, & 160 - Waitress was observed washing hands without proper technique. Handle of paper towel dispenser touched after handwashing was completed to get paper towels. Proper technique was discussed, and staff demonstrated proper technique for the remainder of the inspection.

Employee helping with food prep was observed touching general surfaces (e.g. handles of fridges/freezers, microwaves) with gloved hands and continuing with food prep and also going between glove changes without handwashing. Handwashing between tasks and proper glove use were discussed.

Employees shall properly wash their hands any time hands may have been contaminated, before putting on gloves/between glove changes, and prior to working with food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles.
Gloves are intended for one use and must be changed when they become torn, soiled, or an interruption in task occurs.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Upon inspector's arrival the paper towel dispenser in the women's room was empty. Owner placed paper towels in the dispenser during inspection.

Maintain a supply of soap and paper towels at all handsinks to allow for proper handwashing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed a soiled piece of cardboard duct taped and screwed to the back of the cooler in the kitchen. Cardboard was removed during inspection. Replace with a material that is smooth, non absorbent and easily cleanable.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the coffee maker spout next to the soda fountain to be soiled black and the soda fountain nozzles to be soiled with a syrup build up. Wash, rinse and sanitize coffee maker spout and soda nozzles.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment: Observed the both restrooms to not have hot water available. Hot water is turned off on faucet and when turned on in the men's restroom, the facuet leaks and does not turn off. Repair faucets so that hot water is available in both restrooms.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to be in disrepair: 1) Coldspot chest freezer in the storage area to have a cracked interior lid with exposed insulation inhibiting cleaning and 2) Kenmore chest freezer to have 4 small cracks in the interior lid. Non-food contact surfaces should be designed to be smooth, non absorbent and easily cleanable.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed the concentration of sanitizer in the sanitizer bucket in the prep sink to be 50 ppm chlorine and the inital run on the dish machine to be 0 ppm chlorine. Sanitizer bucket was re-made to 100 ppm chlorine and dish machine sanitizer was primed and retested to be 50 ppm on a subsequent run. Sanitizer bucket concentration of chlorine should be 100 ppm and dish machine should be 50 ppm. 
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following non-food contact surface to be soiled: gasket seal on Kenmore chest freezer in storage area is moldy. Clean gasket seal.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observed raw eggs being stored in a combination fridge in the kitchen above ready to eat food. Eggs were moved to back storage fridge with no ready to eat food below.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.
